name: Neon Night

background.description: Diagonal purple-to-navy linear gradient with about 12 blurred glowing dots (radial gradients in cyan and magenta, 20-60px) floating upward at different speeds

timer.tickEffect: cyan ring drains clockwise, pulses and turns pink on the last 3 seconds

reveal.correctEffect: green glow + scale up to 1.08, plus a tick icon
reveal.wrongOptionEffect: fade to 30% opacity and shrink slightly

contrastNote: text on bg ≈ 15:1 at the lighter purple stop; correct is much brighter than wrong

name: Sunny Pastel

background.description: Soft cream-to-pink vertical gradient with large semi-transparent pastel circles (yellow, mint, sky blue, 80-240px, 35% opacity) scattered across the frame
background.motion: circles bob up and down gently, 12s loop

timer.tickEffect: orange circle with the digit bounces on every second and grows on the last 3

reveal.correctEffect: dark green answer card with white text, burst of pastel confetti
reveal.wrongOptionEffect: fade to 35% opacity with a small sideways wobble

music.mood: playful ukulele and pizzicato, 120 bpm, light claps, no vocals

contrastNote: text on bg ≈ 10:1; correct (dark green) vs wrong (bright coral) differ strongly in brightness; add a tick or cross icon

name: Dark Minimal

background.description: Near-black vertical gradient with a faint radial vignette and a very subtle 1px dot grid at 4% white opacity

timer.tickEffect: large yellow digit fades and slides up each second, turns red on the last 3

reveal.correctEffect: thin mint outline wipes left to right around the correct answer and it brightens
reveal.wrongOptionEffect: text dims to 25% and a thin line strikes through it

music.mood: minimal lo-fi electronic with a soft ticking pulse, 95 bpm, no vocals

contrastNote: text on bg ≈ 16:1; mint correct is far brighter than red wrong

name: Retro Arcade
